name: Stain-Resistant Carpet: What the Warranties Actually Cover
meta-description: Stain-resistant carpet, honestly: topical treatments vs solution-dyed fiber, what the warranties cover and exclude, and the fine print that kills claims.
post-summary: November 12, 2026 · "Stain-resistant" hides two technologies — topical treatments that wear off and solution-dyed fiber that cannot — and the warranty behind the label is a list, not a promise. What is covered, the exclusions that surprise people, the paperwork that decides claims, and the spec we actually install in Shoreline family homes.
